text: Bermuda is a British overseas territory, located north of the Caribbean sea. As such, it is counted as **the United Kingdom** for country streaks purposes.
text_zh: 百慕達是英國的海外領地，位於加勒比海以北。因此，在連續猜國名（country streaks）模式中，它被算作**英國**。

text: Bermuda drives on the **left side** of the road.
text_zh: 百慕達靠道路**左側**行駛。

text: Bermuda features a **black** Street View car with the entire front sides of the vehicle typically visible.
text_zh: 百慕達特徵是一輛**黑色** Google 車，通常可以看到車輛的前兩側大面積車身。

text: The most typical look of Bermuda is somewhat dense vegetation, consisting of fairly small trees and a lot of bushes, combined with single family houses strewn across the landscape.
text_zh: 百慕達最典型的景色是稍微密集的植被，由相當矮小的樹木和大量灌木組成，並散落著獨棟住宅。

text: Bermudan licence plates are all-white, fairly long, and with black digits, somewhat contained to the middle of the plate.
text_zh: 百慕達的車牌全白、相當長，帶有黑色數字，數字稍微集中在車牌中間。

text: Most roads in Bermuda contain a **single solid yellow middle line** with no outer road lines.
text_zh: 百慕達的大多數道路都只有**單條黃色實線中線**，沒有外側道路標線。

text: You will occasionally see these white **zig zag road lines** on Bermuda.
text_zh: 在百慕達你偶爾會看到這種白色的**鋸齒狀道路標線**。

text: Most buildings on Bermuda are single family stone houses painted in **pastel colours**. They will almost always have **completely white roofs**.
text_zh: 百慕達的大多數建築都是塗上**柔和粉彩**的獨棟石造房屋。它們幾乎總是有**全白的屋頂**。

text: **Palms** are very commonly found on Bermuda.
text_zh: 在百慕達非常容易看到**棕櫚樹**。

text: On Bermuda you will never be far away from the ocean, and the water will very often look **distinctly light blue**.
text_zh: 在百慕達你永遠離海洋不遠，而且海水通常看起來呈現**非常明顯的淺藍色**。

text: Hamilton is by far the largest town on Bermuda, and as such, the downtown area is distinct due to its many large, densely built **multi-floor buildings**.
text_zh: 漢彌爾敦是百慕達最大的城鎮，因此市中心區域因其許多大型且密集的**多層建築**而非常獨特。

text: The northwestern tip of Bermuda can be recognised by the many large buildings made of **unpainted grey brick**.
text_zh: 百慕達西北端可以透過許多由**未刷漆灰色磚塊**建造的大型建築來辨識。

text: A **boat trekker** can be seen on the eastern coast of Bermuda. It can be seen going around [Saint George’s Harbour](https://goo.gl/maps/U6Lze1J5ehU1tJqr9) and past [Fort St. Catherine](https://goo.gl/maps/9UciXRzs9WeyiRpv6) on the northeast tip of the island.
text_zh: 在百慕達東岸可以看到**船隻徒步拍攝**。可以看到它環繞[聖喬治港](https://goo.gl/maps/U6Lze1J5ehU1tJqr9)，並穿過島嶼東北端的[聖凱瑟琳堡](https://goo.gl/maps/9UciXRzs9WeyiRpv6)。
